prospect_leg.inventory: Prospects carry WAR paths only in the repository (mlb_projections prospects: war, warP10, warP90, warPTH); milb_translation projects first-MLB K% and BB% only. The per-season line is built from the translation chain, not back-solved from WAR.
prospect_leg.arrival: ETA model: zero before the ETA year, then 1 - S(t) on the eta_eval km_survival_by_level curve for the prospect's level

basis: Value = the sum over 5 seasons (2027 to 2031) of the season's fantasy value above replacement, discounted 7% a season.
Replacement is the first player past a 12-team active lineup each season (12 hitters, 10 pitchers a team): the 145th hitter and 121st pitcher.
MLB players: next season's line from the Redraft projection engine, aged a season at a time on the same curves /projections/ walks.

Prospects: a line built from minor league rates translated to MLB rates, with the playing time past debut classes got in each season after arriving, weighted by the chance he has arrived (zero before his ETA year). No WAR and no grade enters the rank.
